text: If $\uvec_1,\uvec_2,\ldots,\uvec_n$ is an orthonormal basis for a subspace $W$ of $\real^m$, then the matrix transformation that projects vectors in $\real^m$ orthogonally onto $W$ is represented by the matrix $P=QQ^T$ where $$ Q = \begin{bmatrix} \uvec_1 \amp \uvec_2 \amp \ldots \amp \uvec_n \\ \end{bmatrix}\text{.} $$
